name: a daily cap counts from local midnight; a monthly one from its reset day
data use adds up both directions from the adapter counters, and survives a counter restart
a line is out of data once its cap is reached, until the next period
what was used is saved and read back, and lines that are gone are forgotten
Auto combining weighs each line by its top speed while busy; idle time changes nothing
a line that got slower is followed as it is used, fading by half per half-life of busy time
